name: Stata analysis
description: Run Stata do-file lines from the composer, with natural-language questions still going to the agent.

items.name: stata_run
items.description: Run Stata commands in the workspace's Stata session, the same one the user's composer uses.

items.name: stata_describe
items.description: Describe the dataset in memory: variables, types, labels and observation count.
